characters.description: Earth's leading hunter and the Malefic Viper's Chosen is recovering from a serious wound to his soul. With the desolation threat unresolved, he favors taking the initiative against Ell'Hakan instead of waiting for another attack.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: A Valhal-linked fighter and adviser who shares Jake's concern about Ell'Hakan. Her experience with false gods leads her to warn that destroying their visible form may not end them while their bond to faith remains.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: Yip of Yore's Chosen and the leader of an expanding coalition connected to the Holy Church. Jake regards him as Earth's principal political rival and suspects, without proof, that he is linked to the recent desolation.
characters.name: Ell'Hakan

characters.description: Earth's chief political organizer as the Prima Guardian event approaches its end. She gathers leaders and allies around a policy that offers influence and mutual protection to other worlds without direct conquest.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: A political participant who reports on the remaining Prima Guardian worlds and their competition for outside assistance.
characters.name: Kindroth

characters.description: A senior ally and battlefield commander who supports acting against Ell'Hakan but stresses that victory is not enough. Any operation must prevent the target from escaping and ensure that the threat is ended.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: A karmic mage working with Earth's leadership as both an intelligence asset and operative. He helps identify a covert observer serving Ell'Hakan and the Holy Church during the political meeting at Jake's lodge.
characters.name: William

characters.description: An inventor and technical adviser who proposes isolating Ell'Hakan inside a void sphere to block escape and outside aid. He understands the design but cannot yet supply a version adequate for the planned confrontation.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: An Endless Empire true royal who participates in Earth's strategic council. She favors a severe preemptive response to Ell'Hakan's most devoted supporters.
characters.name: Vesperia

characters.description: One of the five leading candidates promoted as administrators when the Milky Way completes the Prima Guardian event.
characters.name: Kindroth

characters.description: A rival primordial who turns the Malefic Viper's apparent injury into an opportunity. He launches a broad offensive against the Order and uses the Viper's silence to strengthen his own account of the conflict.
characters.name: Yip of Yore

characters.description: Jake's primordial patron and the leader of his Order. After confirming that the lingering desolation is probably a false god, he proposes turning Ell'Hakan's hopes for Jake's betrayal into the basis of a larger deception.
characters.name: Malefic Viper

characters.description: A karmically perceptive observer who detected the Malefic Viper's intervention in the restricted universe. His conclusion helped Yip of Yore verify that the primordial had acted and paid a significant price.
characters.name: Eversmile

characters.description: Valhal's first Valkyrie and a central political authority. She directs Carmen to bring Jake into Valhal territory while keeping the coming confrontation between the two primordials insulated from outside interference.
characters.name: Gudrun

characters.description: A powerful Valhal figure bound to help create the conditions for Yip of Yore and the Malefic Viper to settle their conflict. His assigned role is to prevent outside forces from intervening or deciding the confrontation.
characters.name: Valdemar

characters.description: An unidentified man who resists the desolation on a ruined world, retrieves its surviving heart-like fragment, retracts the spreading corruption, and seals the fragment in a box. His identity and purpose remain unknown.
characters.name: Unnamed Man with Desolation Fragment

characters.description: Jake's wind-aligned companion, chosen to travel with him and Carmen into Valhal territory. Her presence among the small party helps demonstrate that Jake is willing to trust Valhal during the developing negotiations.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: The leader of a heavily protected Valhal world and Jake's local host. He receives Jake's party, helps shape their political approach, and presents Valhal as a possible future home and source of protection for the hunter.
characters.name: Bobby

characters.description: A Holy Church augur who serves as the Church's representative when the protected negotiations with Ell'Hakan begin.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: The Boundless Hydra leading the Order's defense while the Malefic Viper remains isolated. He directs the surviving allied gods to withdraw toward Primordial 4, protect Order members, and avoid unnecessary battles.
characters.name: Lord Protector

characters.description: A labyrinth-maker who observes the sealed divine duel alongside the Worm God. He is already occupied with designing the labyrinth intended for the next era, giving him a direct interest in how the struggle between primordials concludes.
characters.name: Minaga

characters.description: A spatial creature able to carry large strike forces across galactic distances. Sandy can reach places already visited or detected, but distance, energy demands, preparation time, and destination knowledge constrain the jumps.
characters.name: Sandy

characters.description: Jacob's guardian, left behind after the augur escapes with the remnants of Ell'Hakan's soul. He remains to face an exhausted Jake on the collapsing planet.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: Ell'Hakan's former right-hand leader and the figurehead of the remaining committed loyalists after Ell'Hakan's death. The leader's identity and ultimate fate remain unresolved.
characters.name: Former Loyalist Leader

characters.description: A pre-System librarian encountered inside a mutable record-world. Known as the Malefic Viper's legendary teacher, he asks Jake to preserve memories of a forgotten city that survives only through his recollection.
characters.name: First Sage

characters.description: A Crimson Flame fire archer and skilled bowyer being urgently recalled from an attempt to earn a high-level dungeon's first-clear title. Jake hopes she can help replace his failing bow.
characters.name: Maria
